environment: Disposable loopback PostgreSQL; synthetic auth.uid shim; mocked provider; no hosted access

Synthetic complete pre-upgrade database survives Phase 1 → 2 → 3 → read-only report fix with UUID/history/roles/notes/audit/index OID unchanged
Incrementally upgraded database authorizes both STABLE reports in read-only transactions while denying patient/anonymous/private-helper access
Incompatible zero-duration, overlapping and invalid demographic fixtures fail safely without deleting/rewriting rows
Anonymous cannot read patient/private appointment tables, mutate appointments or execute private/admin/booking RPCs
Patient own reads and operations work; patient B data/mutations, clinical writes, staff booking, reports and ledger are denied
Role escalation fails for UPDATE, INSERT, UPSERT, admin RPC, malformed UUID, extra RPC arguments and forged metadata
Five concurrency combinations yield exactly one winner under the shared exact-slot rule
09:00:00 valid; seconds/fractions/off-grid rejected; cancelled and no-show slots released
Patient/staff availability is identical and private; inactive/blocked/full/completed/past rules apply
Admin clinical progression works; terminal revival, future check-in and skipped transitions are rejected
Real notification handlers use actual local ledger; duplicate send, 400/429/500/timeout and persistence behavior are correct
CSV neutralizes formulas/leading whitespace while preserving Unicode/quotes/commas/newlines
